Property rules for Vault items, keyed by Category Name. The release workflow runs these against every item in a BOM tree before allowing sync-properties / lifecycle-release to proceed. User-defined properties (Source, Material, Engineer, Designer, etc.) are pulled via propDefIds — see check_item_properties.get_all_item_propdef_ids.

Description rules follow the 'Vault PDM – Item Description' standard (rev A): lowercase keyword nouns only — no dimensions, no material, no ISO/DIN/standard numbers, no project/customer names. ISO/DIN/standard numbers belong in the Title. Revisions are numeric for every category.

Each property may declare any of: required (bool), allowed_values (list), forbidden_values (list), pattern (regex, fullmatch), forbidden_patterns (list of regex, re.search), min_length (int), max_length (int), description (str), required_unless ({property, matches_pattern}). The required_unless clause skips the `required` check when another named property matches a regex (re.search) -- used e.g. to exempt ISO/DIN-standard purchased parts from needing a Vendor entry. Reloaded every run.

Part - Purchased.description: Bought parts (Source = Buy) — must have Vendor + Vendor Number; Material/Engineer/Designer/Project not required.

Title (Item,CO).description: ISO / DIN / standard numbers are allowed here (e.g. 'ISO 4762 M6x20').

Description (Item,CO).description: Lowercase keyword nouns only per Vault PDM – Item Description standard. No dimensions, materials, standards, or project/customer names.

Part - Engineering.description: In-house designed parts (Source = Make) — must have Material + Engineer/Engr Approved By/Project; Vendor not required.

Title (Item,CO).description: ISO / DIN / standard numbers are allowed here.

Description (Item,CO).description: Lowercase keyword nouns only per Vault PDM – Item Description standard.

Material.description: Spell out the material — no abbreviations. Use 'Stainless Steel 304' not 'SS304', 'Aluminum 6061-T6' not 'AL6061', 'Polycarbonate' not 'PC'. Grade designators (304, 6061-T6, etc.) are fine; the leading material noun must be a full word.

Assembly - Engineering.description: Engineering assemblies (Source = Make). Material/Vendor not expected; sign-off + project required.

Title (Item,CO).description: ISO / DIN / standard numbers are allowed here.

Description (Item,CO).description: Lowercase keyword nouns only per Vault PDM – Item Description standard.

DT Parts.description: Design / test parts — lightweight category for tooling, prototypes, and dev hardware that doesn't go through the full engineering release. Identity fields are required; UDPs are tracked but not gated.

Title (Item,CO).description: ISO / DIN / standard numbers are allowed here.

Description (Item,CO).description: Lowercase keyword nouns only per Vault PDM – Item Description standard.

release_gate.description: Stricter rule set used by the release workflow — every item in the BOM must pass these before lifecycle state can advance. The per-category rules above are the source of truth; this section documents the gate behaviour.
